english.note: This is the all-purpose term for classical music, including both the general genre and music from the Mozart era.

examples.english: I listened to classical music all the time when I was learning piano, and I still like it now.
examples.traditional: 我細個學琴嗰陣成日聽古典音樂，依家都仲鍾意。
